conclusion: The three reference Markdown artifacts cannot be certified as train-only from the released repository. The current SkillOpt generation pipeline evaluates candidate skills on valid_seen and uses that score for acceptance and best-skill selection. Treat behavior-initialized results as validation-influenced exploratory evidence, not as a final leakage-free conclusion.
